## Extracted Requirements from CCP-4 (spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:167-181)

### MUST Requirements

- [ ] CCP4-MUST-1: Regional channel plan MUST be provisioned locally (line 169)
- [ ] CCP4-MUST-2: OTA message MUST NOT expand local plan (line 169)
- [ ] CCP4-MUST-3: OTA message MUST NOT increase transmit power (line 169)
- [ ] CCP4-MUST-4: OTA message MUST NOT relax regulatory limits (line 169)
- [ ] CCP4-MUST-5: ADR MUST NOT change PHY profile 0x01 params inside schedule generation (line 179)
- [ ] CCP4-MUST-6: Unknown plan identifiers or versions MUST cause CH0 fallback (line 181)

### MAY Requirements

- [ ] CCP4-MAY-1: Remote capability/schedule messages MAY reduce locally permitted intersection (line 181)

### REQUIRE (future profiles)

- [ ] CCP4-REQUIRE-1: Future profile IDs REQUIRE canonical airtime vectors and new spec revision before use (line 179)

### Plan Contents (informative, lines 171-177)
- plan identifier and version
- ordered channel entries, with CH0 at index zero
- center frequency, bandwidth, spreading factors, coding rates, max power per entry
- regulatory accounting group for each channel
- applicable duty-cycle, dwell-time, occupancy, and LBT rules
- hardware-specific permitted channel mask
